answer: Require every new identity to name five established guardians from five different clusters, who can collectively recover it and who lose standing if it proves fake. A sybil farm must corrupt or buy five diverse guardians per puppet, so attack cost scales with guardians, not puppets, while honest newcomers cross a narrow bridge of trust with real sponsors. Like a jade seal, guardianship is hard to forge and easy to verify; like a mesa, it stands only on broad, independent rock. Limits: guardians can collude or charge fees, and isolated honest users may struggle to find five.
